newsitem.title: HUNGARY: BUSINESSMAN SHOT IN BUDAPEST VIOLENCE SERIES.
newsitem.headline: BUSINESSMAN SHOT IN BUDAPEST VIOLENCE SERIES.

text.p: A Hungarian businessman was shot Tuesday evening in Budapest in a spate of bombings and violent incidents hitting Budapest in the past two months, the police said on Wednesday.
"Taking the past few day's crimes into account, the connection (with the recent handgrenade bombings) cannot be excluded," national police spokesman Laszlo Garamvolgyi told the HUngarian Radio.
Z.Cs., 56, owner of a truck parking lot, was shot several times in the arm and shoulder, and suffered serious injuries, the police said.
Tuesday's incident followed a series of bombings and shootings, which may be connected.
A well-known figure of Budapest's underworld, a prominent racehorse owner and a national box champion and restaurant owner were shot earlier this month. The first of them died.
Several handgrenades have been exploded during the last three months outside night clubs, injuring no one, but causing extensive damage in some cases.
